title: Tall whites' gated compound on Orcas, reached by an unmarked black helicopter

tellings.quote: And he goes they have a compound on the Orcus Island.

plain: Beings known in UFO lore as the tall whites, a supposed race of tall, pale non-humans, keep a gated compound on Orcas Island in Washington State, and an unmarked black helicopter flies in and out of it. A guest named Brent Friedman tells Michels this second-hand, from a friend who lives on Orcas Island and told him, "they have a compound on the Orcas Island." If true, it would mean non-humans are living quietly on American soil with outside help.
